description: This file defines the class Smarty_Internal_Runtime_UpdateScope, which provides methods for updating variable scopes within Smarty templates during runtime. It handles updating variables across different scope levels such as local, parent, global, smarty, and root scopes, and manages the propagation of variable changes.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Runtime_UpdateScope
classes.description: Class providing runtime functionality to update variable scopes within Smarty templates

methods.name: _updateScope
methods.description: Updates template or configuration variables across affected scopes based on scope tags and parameters.

methods.name: _getAffectedScopes
methods.description: Retrieves an array of scope objects affected by the scope update based on the specified merged scope.

methods.name: _updateVariableInOtherScope
methods.description: Synchronizes a variable in another scope with the value from the source template's variable.

methods.name: _updateVarStack
methods.description: Updates the variable stack within a given template for a specified variable name.
